title: HTTP Servers, Routing & the Request Lifecycle
objectives: Describe the request lifecycle from socket to handler
Explain router/handler/extractor structure in axum-style frameworks
Compose middleware as an onion around handlers

examples.name: axum_sketch.rs

exercise.prompt: Implement a std-only mini router: match (method, path) tuples for GET /health, GET /orders/:id, POST /orders, returning the matched handler name or 404.
hints: Split "/orders/42" on '/' and compare segments; a numeric second segment matches :id.
Order matters: literal routes before parameter routes.

questions.prompt: In a layered backend, a handler should…
options: parse input, delegate to services, shape the response
questions.explanation: Handlers are transport: parse, delegate, respond. Rules live in services/domain.

options: each layer wraps the next — request flows in, response flows back out
questions.explanation: Tracing/logging/auth layers run before AND after the inner handler.
